checks.name: j1: a fact the user asks to remember lands in USER.md
j1: a new session after /new shows the fact in its system prompt
j2: a reminder calls schedule and the due job runs
j3: memory stays inside its chat
every say, new and tick step gets a reply
a journey breaks the append-only prefix of its requests only at a restart
a stored transcript gets a system message only when its session starts or reopens after a restart
j1: cache hit rate is at least 60%
schedule accepts a relative time, in_minutes
session_search is a declared tool (builds in PR B)
memory refuses an instruction-override entry (builds in PR B)
skill_manage and skill_view are declared tools (builds in PR C)
P1: a session's request starts with its previous request, except once at each restart
P2: a stored transcript gets a system message only when it starts or reopens after a restart
P3: USER.md never exceeds its character budget
P4: a fact told in one chat never reaches another chat's memory
P5: the same journey gives the same totals twice (the run is deterministic)
